It looks like we can get to the end of the Labyrinth now…
But I wonder who on Earth set up that barrier?

Ha. Not looking too hot there, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
All that skill you have, and yet you still
let #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF make a clean getaway.

Revenge? Nah, not really.
I got no grudge towards you.
I just came here to laugh at you.

―――Fine.
Keep talking, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.
I'll humor you since this piques my interest.
What about me did you come to laugh about?

Isn't it obvious? I'm laughing at how lame you
are. So tunnel-visioned on #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF that you
didn't notice me slip in?

You had barrier-traps set up in your own
Labyrinth, yet you stood around twiddling your
thumbs waiting for #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF to come along?

#C236196003BB#CDEF turned her back on you,
yet you went around flaunting your levels off?

I had myself some good chuckles over
how trash you are.

Maybe some signals are overlapping,
because I hear a conversation going on somewhere far away.

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF? Why is he in the Labyrinth!?
Wait, this is really bad, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF!
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF and #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF are in the same room!

It looks like he was hidden while manipulating
that barrier, but now he has nowhere to hide!
At this rate, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF will…!

…you're pissing me off.
As much of a worm as you are, getting on
people's nerves is one thing you're good at.

But… appearing before me must mean you've said
your prayers, I take it? Or maybe you're here
to beg for your life?

I'll spare you if you cry as you apologize. But
this time, I'll make sure you turn smaller than
a tick. You'll be a nano-sized virus.

Ha. No thanks. You go and keep pretending
you're some King of Drain.

I mean, look. You've got that negative mindset.
You pretend to be all cool,
but deep down you're all clumsy. No style.

No wonder the people you like avoid you like
the plague.
Man, it's sad.

You approach all aggressively but you
still get ignored. Doesn't it hurt? If I were
you, I'd off myself out of embarrassment!

W-what the hell is he thinking…!? Come back
the way you came, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF! #C236196003Shinji#CDEF is
going to get himself―!

"If I were you, I would off myself."
That's what you said, right? ―――Okay.
Then I'll grant your wish, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF―――!

Which one of us is the lame one now?
A Master without his Servant is merely a
human… or rather, experience points.

You've pissed me off quite badly. Your life
alone won't be enough. I'll absorb everything,
down to the #RUBS   smallest unit#RUBElast kilobyte#REND――

No, I'll scale you#RUBS          the absolute smallest unit#RUBE down to 1 planck#REND.
So rejoice, all your talent will be min―gh…

D-damn…!
What, is this―――?
W-w-what's the meaning of this!?

Jeez, man… #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF and the others are so naive.
Only second-rate, gamers worry about, stuff
like, how to deal with, invincibility―――

A hole was bore through #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's abdomen,
and while the virus dissolves his insides,
blood spills from his mouth as he feebly laughs.

Still―――He appeared full of dignity
as no one else has ever shown.

Ghrgh… haha, I kept drinking
without realizing that, and before I knew it,
I hit the limit.

Wh―――what did you say!?
That means… I drained that liability of
minus 999 levels from you…!?

You―a child, narcissistic, and unlovable to
other people―managed to pull this off…!?

Ha! Yeah, that's right!
I'm a kid, I'm selfish, and I couldn't care
less about other people!

But you know, as a gamer, I take issue with
the way you do things.

Seriously――Cheating is flat-out repulsive!
You dumb dumbass!
And did I mention you're a dumbass!?

Ha! Get it, now!?
Don't underestimate the Game Champion of Asia!

#C236196003BB#CDEF confiscated her #C000246204Invincibility#CDEF,
and #C236196003Shinji#CDEF caused her overpowered levels to tank.

At this point, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF is nothing more than
an obstacle that's "possible to defeat."

Time to face the consequences, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF.
For all of the atrocities you've committed――
you'll pay for them now with your head.

Take that! Swift is heaven's vengeance,
karma's retribution! That's what you get for
thinking #C236196003Shinji#CDEF was just some rotten seaweed!

Ah, well, I thought the same way, but watching
him reminded me that even moss can break down
rock. I'll reward him with twice the honor!

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF deserved his victory. Thus, I won't
allow the victor to undergo any further harm.
Now the battle is between you and us.

Ha―――S-so this is what it's come to.
Just like the rest, in the end all I can do
is seclude myself within my own mind, huh?

But know this is just a fleeting dream.
I'll go somewhere no one can bother me
and extract levels from the humans again.

Once I'm back up to a suitable and satisfactory
level, I'll come meet you. Keep pretending to
get along with one another until then!

She's only as strong as any other average Servant right now.
She probably intends to recover her power while inside
one of those statues.

We can't proceed to the Core with that statue blocking our way.
We need to take her out before she hits the level cap again.
But first things first―――

Heh… You saw that, yeah?
This is how top gamers, do#ROFS0004#RUBS      co-op #RUBE cooperation#REND, yo――

He's disintegrating from the wound #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF
gave him and from the virus that was injected afterwards.

The bonds between his Spiritrons are dissolving,
and his exterior is eroding away.
He's like a work of glass that shatters
if you don't handle it right.

…there's no more point in trying to heal or
repair him in any way.
He's not "on the verge of death"; he's already―――

And I did cut off my sense of pain―――
It doesn't hurt a single bit, so it's,
no big, deal―――

Haha… This looks so realistic, my body fading.
Makes me wanna hurl. Not that,
I even CAN hurl, anymore.
…I can't find the words to say.
It would feel wrong to tell him, "thank you."
…that's why this hurts more than it should.

Regardless of his motives, all that matters is that
he faced off against #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF to help #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF.

…tch. Why are you looking at me like that…?
Even in the end, you still rub me the wrong way.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF's attitude is as bad as ever.

He smirks proudly, then aimlessly
looks up toward the Labyrinth's sky.

I'm talking about the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.
It still pisses me off.
I lost to you.

…yeah.
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF and I fought each other in the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

It was in the 1st Round, where neither I, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF,
nor any of the many Masters had come to terms
with the fact that it was a "real battle royale."

#C236196003Shinji#CDEF had lost to #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF and
vanished while exclaiming his resentment.
…that's why I really don't understand this.

Thinking back on his final moments,
I would never have imagined #C236196003Shinji#CDEF throwing
his life away for the person who killed him.

I would've thought that all he had in him
was hatred towards #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, yet―――

Yeah, you DO really piss me off.
Even now I still hate your ass.

Around the 2nd or 3rd Round.
You thought about me and cried, didn't you?
I know you did.

Now that he mentions it, I think that did happen.
In the middle of my battles, I thought about all the
Masters I had overcome and started whining about it.
But… but, that's the reason?

I didn't leave behind a winning score for the
#C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF, but――
That, at least, I did leave behind.

…ha. What's wrong with me? Looks like when
you're about to die, you start falling for that
humanism crap―you start turning stupid.

If you disappear now, no one is gonna cry for
me, right? That's what I thought, so then
I figured "I guess I gotta do this."

…it really did, scare me. I didn't want to,
do this. But I thought hard about it:
you were my actual, my first, friend.

Goddamnit… It's true.
If I went back, to the Near Side, I'd disappear.
I was zeroed, this whole time.

With that the case―――
I needed to leave something―――

Then, even as dull as you are―――
I needed someone, left―――
who would remember, me―――

With a condescending smile on his face,
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF completely disintegrates.

Like #C236196003Gatou#CDEF, he was an already-dead Master.
A dead man who could only exist on the
#C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.

A boy who was eliminated in the 1st Round
of the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF―remaining in no one's memories
and leaving no fantastic score behind.

…but in the very, very end,
he left #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF behind.

Not some glorious, personal score……
he left behind a worthless friend who cried for him.

…#C236196003Shinji#CDEF's vitals have terminated.
Records of him from within the Far Side
are gone from the server.

…unbelievable. Gamers are no joke.
Your pride was top-notch.
You looked pretty cool out there, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.
This must be #C236196003Rin#CDEF's way of saying goodbye.
I follow her by thanking #C236196003Shinji#CDEF in my head, then stand up.

We're going to immediately set you up to
dive into #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's statue.

I know.
I won't waste this chance #C236196003Shinji#CDEF carved out for us.

We need to finish off #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF before
she returns to her previous level―――!

Around here, there should be a checkpoint.
Once you―

Comms from the Student Council Room cut out,
and Noise rushes through the Labyrinth.

…I don't get surprised by this anymore.
This is what happens when #C236196003BB#CDEF meddles with
things from outside the Labyrinth.

This is self-destruction. More self-destruction.
Even I can't help but get the sense that conti-
…bserve self-destructive creatures is futile.

Throughout the Labyrinth where comms from the Student
Council Room have completely cut out, #C236196003BB#CDEF's voice echoes coldly.

……that goes for you, too.
Why are you in the Labyrinth?

It's illogical. You STILL haven't quit. In life,
one follows the route with the best chance
of survival. Stop defying your instincts.

It's the other way around.
I'm here BECAUSE I'm following my instincts to survive.

The moment I looked at #C236196003BB#CDEF to tell her that,
I sensed that something was out of place.

#C236196003BB#CDEF's voice… no, her tone, gestures―various aspects of her
demeanor have begun to change compared to how she used to be.

Regardless of how, like, rogue she's gone, or how evil she is,
#C236196003BB#CDEF was always a girl brimming with life.

I don't sense any of that vigor within the
virtual projection there. If #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF was right,
that messing with the Core has caused #C236196003BB#CDEF to start
breaking down, then…

…what is it?
If you have a question then please verbalize it.

A puny human's opinion is nothing worth
me even considering, let alone acting on.

She's saying she refuses me,
but the circuit between us is still open.
…no, there's no use in trying to understand #C236196003BB#CDEF.
There's no taking back what's been done at this point.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is an enemy I must defeat.
I won't be able to protect the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF
unless I'm prepared to do so.

She's an enemy I must defeat.
There's no refuting that fact.

Still, just because that's true doesn't mean I should
be feeling happy about her self-destructing, I think.

I'm fighting to protect the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF,
and at the same time,
I'm afraid that the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF will delete #C236196003BB#CDEF.
That's why―――
I want you to leave the Core alone.
Bracing myself, I say that out loud.

―――That cannot be done. So long as this
#RUBS    Cursed   Cutting   Crater#RUBEImaginary Spiritron Pit#REND is forming, I will
be integrating with the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

I'm incapable of viewing the difference
as any sort of issue.
…I can't, not anymore.

She integrated with the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF already…?
Something is off about what #C236196003BB#CDEF is saying.
It's not adding up.
However, it's a fundamental law that AI's don't lie.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is speaking the truth.
Yet, the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is still safe and sound.
So what's the deal with this discrepancy here―――

It appears that you have no further questions.
Then―――

Hold on.
I have a question, too. Masters aren't the only
ones with the right to speak, yes?

Please wait. Since this truly seems
to be our last chance, there's one more
thing I would like to point out.

Wait. There will never be another AI as foolish
as you. I acknowledge that you're a rare
specimen, so I suppose I'll indulge you.

My question is…
No, let's check one last thing.

Straight to the point, huh? I used to appreciate
your fondness of entertainment, regardless of
the content. Oh well.

I'll be brief, as well. #C236196003BB#CDEF.
Your goal isn't to seize the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF,
it's HOW you'll achieve your goal, isn't it?

Then how about I check something?
#C236196003BB#CDEF. It's not the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF that you're after.

Taking control of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is the means,
a tool to help you achieve another goal, right?

You don't actually give a hoot about the
#C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, am I right? Your true objective
lies somewhere else, doesn't it?

Come, now. You spoke of controlling humanity,
but that's not your true goal. You sought
to take the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF for another reason, no?

#C236196003BB#CDEF. You didn't turn to evil because you went
rogue; haven't you purposefully gone rogue so
that you could become what you are now?

―――No. You're mistaken about that point.
I will integrate with the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, and
as the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF, I will supervise humanity.

Even if humanity collapses by their #ROFS-001#RUBSinfantilism#RUBEneoteny#REND,
I deem it to be appropriate.
Humanity's end will be self-wrought.

But――that old school building is an exception.
